TERMS AND CONDITIONS
FOR THE SERVICES
1. SCOPE OF WORK & ENGAGEMENT
Defined Roles: Services may include :
Cinematography D.I.T. Editing DI Color Grading Visual Effects
Scope of work agreed :
  • Any services not expressly listed herein or in a separate signed Project Quote/Estimate shall be treated as out-of-scope and shall require a separate written agreement and pricing confirmed by both Parties prior to commencement.
  • Payment of the advance deposit or commencement of work constitutes the Client's (Client Name) full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms. Saksham Goel ("the Service Provider") operates strictly as an independent contractor.
  • The agreed deliverables for the project comprise creative services as mutually confirmed.
2. FINANCIAL TERMS
  • A non-refundable advance is required to secure dates and commence work. The balance shall be due prior to or parallel to final delivery.
  • Overdue payments shall accrue interest at 18% per annum, calculated daily.
  • All fees are exclusive of GST. If the Client deducts statutory TDS, they must issue the corresponding TDS certificate within the statutory timeline.
3. WORKING HOURS & REVISIONS
  • For agreed roles and deliverables (Cinematography, Editing, Color grading and Sound design), a standard working schedule and milestones are established as mutually agreed. Work beyond agreed milestones or on-site schedules constitutes overtime and is charged at rates agreed in advance.
  • The agreed fee covers a maximum of two (2) rounds of minor, consolidated creative revisions. Structural changes or alterations to agreed technical specs will be billed independently. Watermarked files are provided for approval; unwatermarked deliverables are released only upon full payment.
4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY (IP) & CREDIT
  • Copyright in the final delivered work vests in the Client only upon receipt of full and cleared payment of all amounts due under the relevant Invoice. Until such time, the Artist retains all intellectual property rights.
  • The Artist irrevocably retains the non-exclusive right to use excerpts and final deliverables for portfolio and self-promotional purposes following public release.
  • The Client agrees to credit Saksham Goel in the final deliverables/work in a manner consistent with the role(s) performed (e.g., “Cinematography, Editing, Color grading and Sound design by Saksham Goel”).
Page 3 of 3: Acceptance & Sign-off
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
FOR THE SERVICES
5. DATA MANAGEMENT, LIABILITY & INDEMNITY
  • The Client is responsible for supplying adequate working storage drives. Project data is retained for a maximum of seven (7) days post-delivery. The Artist assumes zero liability for data corruption or hardware failure after handover.
  • The Client warrants they hold all necessary licenses for provided third-party assets (e.g., music, logos) and fully indemnifies the Artist against any related claims.
  • The Artist's liability for any technical failure or omission is strictly capped at the actual amount paid for that specific service. The Artist is not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
  • Where the Client provides equipment, such equipment must be in full working order. The Artist shall not be liable for production delays arising from faulty Client-provided or rental equipment.
6. CANCELLATIONS & DELAYS
  • If the Client cancels a confirmed shoot date:
    (i) More than 48 hours prior: the deposit paid shall be forfeited.
    (ii) Within 48 hours of shoot: 100% of remaining agreed rate is payable in addition to deposit.
  • Post-production projects paused by the Client for over 30 days will incur a Re-initiation Fee.
  • Neither party is liable for non-performance caused by events beyond reasonable control (force majeure).
7. GOVERNING LAW & JURISDICTION
This agreement is governed by the laws of India. Any unresolved disputes shall be referred to a court of law having applicable jurisdiction in Mumbai.
8. CONFIDENTIALITY
  • Each Party agrees to hold in strict confidence all non-public information, raw footage, unreleased content, and scripts disclosed during this engagement. This obligation survives termination for a period of two (2) years.
9. GENERAL PROVISIONS
  • This Agreement, together with the applicable Invoice, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties.
  • No modification to this Agreement shall be valid unless made in writing and signed by both Parties.
